# Bloodsuckers
[color=#8b0000]An undead predator hiding among the crew, feeding in secret and binding mortals to its will.[/color]
One Bloodsucker can awaken at the start of a shift. They look like anyone else, but under examination they are unnaturally pale.
## Feeding
Use [bold]Feed[/bold] on a victim to drink their blood. Feeding from a hard grab bites the neck and puts the victim to sleep, but everyone nearby sees it. Feeding on the wrist is quieter. Being seen feeding breaks the Masquerade.
## Sol
Every 10 minutes the sun rises over the station for 4 minutes. Bloodsuckers are warned one minute before. During [color=orange]Sol[/color] a Bloodsucker burns unless they rest inside a claimed coffin. Use [bold]Claim[/bold] on a coffin to make it your lair. Burns only heal near your coffin.
## Ranks
A Bloodsucker ranks up for every Sol slept through in their coffin and for every 300u of blood they drink. Each rank unlocks new powers:
- [bold]Rank 1:[/bold] Feed, Claim, Sense cycle, Masquerade, Brawn - [bold]Rank 2:[/bold] Materialize rack, Vassalize, Beguile, Sanguine Olfaction, Immortal Haste - [bold]Rank 3:[/bold] Predatory Lunge, Help Vassal, Veil of Many Faces - [bold]Rank 4:[/bold] Mesmerize, Cloak of Darkness - [bold]Rank 5:[/bold] Trespass, Fortitude - [bold]Rank 6:[/bold] Vanishing Act
## Vassals
A Bloodsucker can bind crew members as [color=#8b0000]vassals[/color] by strapping them to a persuasion rack and using Vassalize, or by offering them the dark gift with Beguile. Vassals serve their master and share their goals. Mindshielded crew and the Chaplain cannot be beguiled.
## Humanity
Every Bloodsucker walks a line between hiding as a mortal and becoming a monster.
[bold]Losing humanity:[/bold] draining a victim to the brink of death, being seen feeding, and vassalizing on the rack. [bold]Gaining humanity:[/bold] letting a victim go before they are in danger, and resting through Sol in a coffin.
[color=#a0c0ff][bold]Masquerade path (70 humanity and above)[/bold][/color] - Feeding on a sleeping victim leaves no trace and never breaks the Masquerade. - Blood packs from Medbay can be drunk with Feed. They count toward rank at half the rate. - Beguile works: a willing crew member can accept the dark gift and become a vassal without a rack. - Mesmerize also wipes the victim's memory of the last minute. - Resting through Sol grants two ranks instead of one.
[color=red][bold]Monster path (low humanity)[/bold][/color] - Feeding drains faster and Brawn hits harder the lower your humanity. - Frenzy starts earlier and burns harder. - Below 30 humanity you can no longer use Masquerade or Veil, and examining you shows glowing red eyes and fangs.
## Fighting Bloodsuckers
- Bullets pass straight through them, lasers do less damage and disablers barely tire them. - Ordinary melee weapons barely hurt them. - [color=gold]Holy water[/color] burns them, whether splashed on them or in their blood. Feeding on someone with holy water in their veins hurts them too. - The [bold]Chaplain[/bold] can bless a melee weapon with their bible. For 10 minutes it glows with holy light and deals heavy holy damage to Bloodsuckers. - While masquerading, a Bloodsucker loses all of these protections, and taking 30 damage breaks the Masquerade and reveals them.
